name: Hand-Drawn Animation: Location Interior
description: Image preset for a location interior in the Hand-Drawn Animation look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for an interior. List the room's purpose, three props that say who uses it, and the light source from the entity, then apply the style.
context_prompt: interior view of the location from a doorway or corner, key furniture and props in place, light source visible, room for characters to stand, classic hand-drawn 2D animation cel, confident tapered ink line, simple rounded shapes built to move, flat colour with one soft shadow pass, gouache painted background, warm storybook palette, soft ambient light
negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3d render, anime, gritty texture, extra limbs, blurry, text, watermark
